sayitenglish.desc.learning: The language you are learning. Every player picks their own, also on a server.
sayitenglish.desc.engine: How your voice is understood. Vosk works offline. Groq needs a free key and the internet. Typing: no microphone, you type the answers.
sayitenglish.desc.key: Your Groq API key (gsk_…). It stays on this computer.
sayitenglish.desc.mic: The microphone SayIt listens to, with a live sound test.
sayitenglish.desc.voice: Who reads the words aloud and how they sound: Piper (natural, offline), your computer's voices or ElevenLabs.
sayitenglish.desc.level: What you are asked. Beginner: item names only. Intermediate: also places, biomes, creatures, numbers and colours. Advanced: everything, sentences too.
sayitenglish.desc.mode: %1$s: the word is shown in the language you learn. %2$s: only your own language at first, the answer shows up halfway.
sayitenglish.desc.penalty: What happens when you don't say an item's name in time.
sayitenglish.desc.extra: A second penalty that comes on top of the first one.
sayitenglish.desc.time: How many seconds you have to say a word. Sentences get a third more.
sayitenglish.desc.strikes: Hard mode: this many wrong answers in a row and you die.
sayitenglish.desc.rewards: A short good effect (speed, haste, luck…) for every right answer.
sayitenglish.desc.reviews: Learned words come back after 1, 3, 7 and 30 days so they stick. Reviews never take anything away.
sayitenglish.desc.repeat: Often: learned words come back as practice every minute and a half while you carry the item.
sayitenglish.desc.look: Now and then, the block you look at is asked, even if you don't carry it.
sayitenglish.desc.quiz: How often a multiple-choice question about a learned word comes up.
sayitenglish.desc.input: Answer multiple choice with the answer keys (keypad 1-4) or with the mouse in a window.
sayitenglish.desc.sentences: Short spoken sentences about what you just did (crafting, fighting, travelling).
sayitenglish.desc.pass: How good your pronunciation must be to count as right. Lower is easier.
sayitenglish.desc.panel: Where the question panel and the teacher sit on the screen. Drag them in the preview.
sayitenglish.desc.teacher: The villager teacher next to the panel. It reacts to your answers and helps when you're stuck.
sayitenglish.desc.highlight: In sentences, the word that names the thing is coloured.
sayitenglish.desc.immersion: Every item and block you've learned shows in the language you're learning, everywhere in the game.
sayitenglish.desc.readings: The reading line under the word (pinyin, and Latin letters for Russian, Ukrainian and Korean).
sayitenglish.desc.ja_reading: What is shown under Japanese words: furigana, romaji, both or nothing.
sayitenglish.desc.ja_spaces: Spaces between Japanese words and particles in the reading.
sayitenglish.desc.crown: The best speaker on a server wears a crown everyone can see. Turn it off to hide yours.
sayitenglish.desc.time_tries: No timer: you lose the word after %s wrong tries.
sayitenglish.chat.paused: SayIt is paused: no questions until you press %s again.
sayitenglish.desc.paused: Take a break: no questions, reviews or penalties until you turn it back on. Also with the pause key (B).
sayitenglish.hud.trade: Say it to the villager in %s
sayitenglish.chat.trade_discount: The villager is pleased: %s is %s %s cheaper this time!
sayitenglish.desc.zh_reading: How the reading under Chinese words is written: Zhuyin, as taught in Taiwan, or pinyin.
sayitenglish.desc.reading_letters: How the reading is spelled: with your own language's letters (Pşeniçne for Turkish, Pschenytschne for German) or the usual English-based ones.
sayitenglish.dictionary.no_creatures: Say a creature's name when you meet one and it shows up here.
sayitenglish.desc.creature_lock: An animal can't be hit, tamed, bred or fed until you say its name. Hostile creatures can always be fought; their name is asked at the first hit.
sayitenglish.desc.trades: At a villager's trade screen, the name of something it sells is asked; say it right and that trade is cheaper.
sayitenglish.dictionary.export_tip: Save all your words as flashcards to study outside the game (opens in the free Anki app, or any spreadsheet).
sayitenglish.dictionary.practice_tip: Click a word in the list first to practise just that one until you say it right. Nothing picked: a random word.
key.sayitenglish.compare: Hear yourself (your voice, then the teacher's)
sayitenglish.echo.none: Say a word out loud first, then press this to hear your voice next to the teacher's.
sayitenglish.guide.title: Guide
sayitenglish.guide.say.title: Say what you find
sayitenglish.guide.say.text:
When you pick up something new, its name shows up in the language you learn. Say it out loud before the bar runs out. Your score shows what the microphone heard; red letters are the ones to say better.
Can't talk right now? Type the answer, or pick it in multiple choice. Wrong answers cost a little (Settings › Questions), right ones give rewards.
sayitenglish.guide.keys.title: Your keys
sayitenglish.guide.keys.text: After an answer, press Hear yourself: your own voice plays, then the teacher's, so you hear the difference. Change keys in Options › Controls.
sayitenglish.guide.dictionary.title: Pocket Dictionary
sayitenglish.guide.dictionary.text: Everything you learned, with how well you know it (New → ★ Master). Click a word to hear it, then Practice to get just that word until you say it right. The group button sorts by food, tools, blocks. Creatures shows the animals and monsters you named. Flashcards saves your words to study outside the game.
sayitenglish.guide.rewards.title: Rewards
sayitenglish.guide.rewards.text: Open a villager's trades and say what it sells: that trade gets cheaper for a whole day. Every day: 5 new words, 2 extra questions and 3 reviews for levels and emeralds. Keep your daily streak, win the crown, race your friends. All settings: U.
sayitenglish.desc.save_progress: Saves every word, creature and review of this world as a file in config/sayitenglish/export, to keep it or take it to another world.
sayitenglish.desc.load_progress: Adds a saved progress file to this world. Nothing is lost: each word keeps its better score. On a server only operators can load.
sayitenglish.desc.guide: Shows the short guide from the first start again.
sayitenglish.progress.op_only: Only an operator can load progress on this server.
sayitenglish.progress.bad_file: That is not a SayIt progress file.
sayitenglish.progress.too_big: That progress file is too big to send to this server.
sayitenglish.progress.put_here: Put your progress file (.json) in this folder, then press Load progress again: %s
sayitenglish.group.tip: Click to show one group: food, tools and armor, blocks or other items. The numbers are learned / in the game.
sayitenglish.chat.goals_done: All daily goals done! +2 levels and 3 emeralds.
sayitenglish.desc.teacher_talk: Now and then the teacher says something in the language you learn: the name of a learned item you take in hand, or a sentence when it rains or night falls.
